topics.name: Strategy
topics.description: Platform strategy, development roadmaps, citizen development, technical governance, and user experience considerations for platform ownership.

introduction.overview: Platform strategy encompasses how organizations align their ServiceNow investments with business objectives. As a Platform Owner, you must understand roadmap development, citizen development enablement, technical governance, and user experience considerations.
introduction.whyItMatters: Strategy accounts for approximately 21.4% of the CPOA exam. Questions focus on how to create platform roadmaps, enable citizen development safely, implement technical governance coding best practices, and consider user experience in platform decisions.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the key inputs to platform roadmaps (business objectives, ServiceNow releases). Understand how Flow Designer with delegated development enables citizen development. Master the role of CMDB in protecting the technology landscape and the impact of not having contextual CMDB data.
introduction.examTips: Focus on strategic alignment between platform capabilities and business needs. Remember that citizen development is enabled through low-code tools with proper governance. Know that PMO Functions require high engagement during implementation phases.

topics.name: People
topics.description: Organizational change management, certifications, sponsorship engagement, roles, partners, and knowledge management governance.

introduction.overview: People management in platform ownership involves OCM Community Champions, certifications and skills alignment, communication planning, partner management, and knowledge governance. Success depends on having the right people with the right skills and sponsors who are committed.
introduction.whyItMatters: People accounts for approximately 15.7% of the CPOA exam. Questions focus on OCM Champion roles, resolving departmental conflicts through governance, matching certifications to project needs, and managing knowledge effectively.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the scope of OCM Community Champions in driving adoption within departments. Know how to resolve conflicts between IT and Security through governance meetings. Match certifications to skills (CAD for development, CSA for administration).
introduction.examTips: Remember that sponsorship engagement fails when sponsors lack authority or commitment. ServiceNow Partner Portal is the official source for partner information. Knowledge management requires governance with lifecycle management and reviews.

topics.name: Process
topics.description: Software development lifecycle (SDLC), code promotion with Update Sets, deployment processes, Now Create, and development environment strategy.

introduction.overview: Process management for Platform Owners involves understanding SDLC methodologies, code promotion processes, and environment strategies. Knowing when to use Waterfall vs Agile and how to properly promote code through development, test, and production instances is essential.
introduction.whyItMatters: Process accounts for approximately 15.7% of the CPOA exam. Questions test your knowledge of deployment stages in Now Create, proper code promotion using Update Sets, and the benefits and drawbacks of different SDLC approaches.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the Now Create deployment process stages. Understand that Update Sets are the standard method for code promotion. Remember that development should NEVER be done directly in production. Know the flexibility benefits of Agile vs the rigidity of Waterfall.
introduction.examTips: Focus on the sequence of deployment stages: development → testing/validation → production. Remember that multiple instances (dev/test/prod) enable safe testing before affecting end users.

topics.name: Technology
topics.description: Upgrades, cloning, patches, testing, instance management, Instance Data Replication, Hermes messaging, and platform core services.

introduction.overview: Technology domain covers the technical aspects of platform management including Instance Data Replication (IDR), Hermes messaging for high availability, upgrade best practices, and cloning with data preservers. Understanding these technical foundations is crucial for platform stability.
introduction.whyItMatters: Technology accounts for approximately 22.9% of the CPOA exam - the largest domain. Questions focus on IDR adapters and monitoring, Hermes near/far cluster architecture, AHA transfer processes, and upgrade best practices.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand how IDR replicates data between instances and its various adapters (Calculation, Map, Time Zone Conversion). Know the difference between near and far clusters in Hermes and how AHA transfer switches to the newly-active data center cluster.
introduction.examTips: Never apply upgrades directly to production without testing in sub-production first. The IDR Monitoring Dashboard tracks producer/consumer replication sets, scheduled jobs, and seeding requests. Messages go to the near cluster under normal operation.

topics.name: Data
topics.description: Data strategy, foundational vs transactional data, reporting, Performance Analytics, compliance, Strategic Planning Workspace, and value-driven metrics.

introduction.overview: Data management for Platform Owners involves understanding data types, reporting capabilities, compliance requirements, and value metrics. Quality data drives accurate reporting, automation, and informed decision-making across the platform.
introduction.whyItMatters: Data accounts for approximately 11.4% of the CPOA exam. Questions test your understanding of foundational vs transactional data, when to use Performance Analytics vs standard Reporting, and where to find compliance information.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know that foundational data (users, CIs) rarely changes while transactional data (incidents, changes) is created frequently. Use Performance Analytics for time-series trends and KPIs. TRUST Center is the official source for compliance information.
introduction.examTips: MTTR is an example of a value-driven metric. Strategic Planning Workspace (SPW) is used for planning strategic initiatives and portfolio alignment, not office space.

topics.name: ServiceNow Governance
topics.description: Licensing types and channels, subscriptions, integration options, governance levels, Service Catalog licensing implications, and KPIs like CSAT.

introduction.overview: ServiceNow Governance covers licensing management, integration planning, and organizational governance structures. Platform Owners must understand licensing implications of platform expansion and the three levels of governance.
introduction.whyItMatters: ServiceNow Governance accounts for approximately 12.9% of the CPOA exam. Questions focus on licensing types (fulfiller, user), official transaction channels, integration options, and governance levels.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the official channels for license transactions (ServiceNow Store, Customer Success Center). Understand the three governance levels: Strategic/Executive, Portfolio/Demand, and Technical. Integration options include native, Integration Hub, third-party, and custom.
introduction.examTips: Service Catalog adoption has licensing implications for both requesters (user licenses) and fulfillers (agent licenses), plus any Integration Hub spoke transactions. CSAT is a key KPI maintained by ServiceNow for customer satisfaction.
